name: Oregon
dueDateNotes: Oregon follows the federal schedule: April 15, June 15, September 15, and January 15.
selfEmploymentNotes: Oregon applies graduated rates to your federal AGI after its standard deduction and a federal income-tax subtraction (up to $8,500 for 2025, phased out between $125,000 and $145,000 of AGI), which this estimate includes. It does not include Portland-area local taxes or Oregon's optional reduced pass-through rate.
uniqueFacts: Oregon has no sales tax but among the nation's highest income tax rates, topping out at 9.9%.
Oregon lets you subtract some of the federal income tax you owe (up to $8,500 for 2025, phased out above $125,000 of income), which lowers your Oregon tax; this calculator factors it in.
Portland-area residents may owe additional local taxes (Metro Supportive Housing and Multnomah County Preschool) that this state estimate does not include.
